english.note: Use this shorter everyday word when the suit context makes clear that you mean a waistcoat rather than another sleeveless garment.

examples.english: Your suit jacket is on; don’t forget the waistcoat.
examples.traditional: 你件西裝褸都著好喇，唔好漏咗件背心呀。
